comment: The HUMAN-OWNED cells of docs/HONESTY-MATRIX.md — the 'reachable via shipped policy DX?' column ONLY. Every other column is derived by lake exe honesty_matrix + scripts/honesty-matrix.mjs, and the renderer rejects an entry that tries to assert a derivable column. Each entry must carry who asserted it and when; the renderer refuses to render without both. Re-assert (update the date) whenever the shipped DX changes.

entries.value: yes — required section of every signed config
entries.rationale: CONFIG.md documents the `safety` section as a required field of the signed TrustedConfig envelope (verified with --pubkey). The shipped DX is hand-authored JSON: no `seal init` scaffolding exists in this repo (workstream A never happened).

entries.value: yes — optional section; kernel active even when absent
entries.rationale: CONFIG.md: absent `temporal` section = no temporal constraints, but the kernel itself is unconditional. Hand-authored signed JSON; no scaffolding CLI.
CONFIG.md documents the section schema (roster, votes_file, high_stakes). Reachable means writing that JSON by hand and signing it; no `seal init`.
CONFIG.md documents the section schema (replicated tools). Hand-authored signed JSON; no scaffolding CLI.

entries.value: yes — optional `calibration` section with `enabled` flag, hand-authored
entries.rationale: CONFIG.md documents the section including the double gate: a present section with enabled:false is explicitly inactive (CONFIG.md's PRESENT-BUT-INACTIVE label). Hand-authored signed JSON; no scaffolding CLI.
CONFIG.md documents the section schema (grants_file, tools). Hand-authored signed JSON; no scaffolding CLI.
CONFIG.md documents the section schema (named caps over tool sets). Hand-authored signed JSON; no scaffolding CLI.

Nothing in CONFIG.md or the config parser (Host/Config.lean) names this kernel; there is no JSON key a user could write that selects it. Consistent with the proof (Ffi.byteConsensus_never_registered) but asserted separately: absence from the DOCUMENTED DX surface is a human reading of CONFIG.md, not a theorem.
